name: @dataflow-visualizer/renderer-svg
description: SVG renderer for the dataflow visualizer

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target browser --sourcemap=external --external @dataflow-visualizer/layout --external @dataflow-visualizer/protocol --external @dataflow-visualizer/runtime && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
